findings.evidence: `rg` finds “obtained by inducing its characters” at line 28 and “representations induced from it” at line 225; the roadmap instead specifies `GL2Cuspidal` of dimension `q−1` and cites Deligne–Lusztig theory at README lines 492–495 and 607.
findings.fix: Replace both induction claims with a faithful statement that the torus parametrizes/enters the Deligne–Lusztig construction of cuspidal representations; retain only the independently correct claim that cuspidals are absent from principal series.
findings.issue: Lines 27–29 and 224–225 claim cuspidal representations are obtained by inducing characters of `Eˣ`; ordinary `Ind_{Eˣ}^{GL₂(F)}` has dimension `[GL₂(F):Eˣ] = q(q−1)`, not the cuspidal dimension `q−1`.

summary: The construction is mathematically sound, but its documentation falsely identifies ordinary induction from the non-split torus as the cuspidal construction.
